name: Gemini
source: You play as either Trisha or Michael Blackhawk, twin siblings working in their own ways to put a stop to the newest threat to their city. Along the way, Michael will try to rekindle a relationship with an old girlfriend while Trisha will try to form a bond with a dangerous woman.
translation: 你扮演特丽莎或迈克尔·布莱克霍克，这对双胞胎兄弟以自己的方式努力阻止对他们城市的最新威胁。一路上，迈克尔将试图与一位旧女友重归于好，而特丽莎将试图与一位危险的女人建立联系。
